FIELDS.NAME: Pinnacle Engineering & Surveying Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pinnacle Engineering & Surveying Solutions, we specialize in providing comprehensive engineering and surveying services tailored to meet the needs of residential, commercial, and public sector projects. Our operations encompass a range of activities including site assessments, boundary surveys, topographic mapping, and civil engineering consultations. We pride ourselves on utilizing advanced technology and well-maintained equipment to ensure precise data collection and analysis. Our team, comprised of licensed and certified professionals, adheres to rigorous industry standards and practices robust risk management protocols to mitigate any operational hazards. We are committed to delivering high-quality results while maintaining full compliance with all regulatory requirements, ensuring a safe and effective project execution for our clients.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Pinnacle Surveying Solutions, LLC - A subsidiary focused on providing land surveying services for residential and commercial properties.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, our firm experienced a loss due to unexpected project delays caused by inclement weather, leading to additional expenses totaling $5,000. The claim has been resolved, and we have implemented revised scheduling protocols to mitigate future occurrences.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $2,500 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade A, Secured Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and the utilization of on-site watchpersons during project execution to ensure safety and compliance.
